# sdwan_transport_cellular_controller_feature_associate_gps_feature (Data Source)

This data source can read the Transport Cellular Controller Feature Associate GPS Feature .

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sdwan_transport_cellular_controller_feature_associate_gps_feature" "example" {
  feature_profile_id                       = "f6dd22c8-0b4f-496c-9a0b-6813d1f8b8ac"
  transport_cellular_controller_feature_id = "140331f6-5418-4755-a059-13c77eb96037"
  id                                       = "f6b2c44c-693c-4763-b010-895aa3d236bd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `feature_profile_id` (String) Feature Profile ID
- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `transport_cellular_controller_feature_id` (String) Transport Cellular Controller Feature ID

### Read-Only

- `transport_gps_feature_id` (String) Transport GPS Feature ID
- `version` (Number) The version of the object
